name: Entity Browser Validation
description: Flags the Entity Browser entity-reference field widget in red when its field fails validation, matching core's error styling.
project_description: The Entity Browser entity-reference widget lacks a targetable form element, so when its field fails validation Drupal cannot visually flag it the way it flags standard inputs, selects and textareas. This module implements hook_field_widget_single_element_entity_browser_entity_reference_form_alter to add a name attribute (built from the field name and the form's #parents) to the entity browser widget wrapper, giving the error-flagging mechanism a target, and attaches a small CSS library that highlights the flagged widget in red. Because the highlight relies on the same 'error' class core uses, the styling can be overridden from a theme. It has no configuration, routes, permissions or services. The maintainer notes the feature ideally belongs in Entity Browser itself, which would make this module obsolete.
